Creator Content Brief

WalkingPad R3 Hybrid+

One treadmill. Two ways to move — from everyday walking to dedicated workouts.
01

Campaign Goal

Show how the WalkingPad R3 Hybrid+ fits naturally into everyday life, helping people add more movement to their routine and switch to a dedicated treadmill workout whenever they want.

Make the 2-in-1 concept visual.

Don't simply say it can be used for both walking and running. Show how the same product moves from everyday activity to real exercise.

02

Core Product Focus

Show the R3 Hybrid+ through real-life situations, not just as a treadmill. The everyday scenario can be adapted to your own content style and audience.

Everyday Movement

WalkingPad Mode

Show how the R3 can fit naturally into light everyday activities — whether you're working or simply going about your day.

  • Working at a standing desk or answering emails
  • Taking a phone call
  • Holding or taking care of a child
  • Watching videos or catching up on content
  • Reading or handling simple daily tasks
Workout Mode

Treadmill Mode

When it's time to exercise, transition the R3 into a dedicated treadmill for a more focused workout.

  • Walking
  • Jogging
  • Running
  • Short home workouts
The key: Show the transition. Instead of simply saying the R3 is a 2-in-1 treadmill, visually show the change from everyday walking → dedicated workout.

04

Suggested Content Flow

Use this as a flexible storytelling structure. Adapt the opening and everyday scenario to your own content style.

01

Start With Your Reality

Open with a relatable situation, routine, or visual hook.

02

Show Everyday Movement

Show your natural use case — working, taking a call, taking care of a child, watching content, or another simple daily activity.

03

Make the Switch

Create a clear visual transition from everyday walking to workout mode.

04

Show the Workout

Demonstrate the R3 as a real treadmill through walking, jogging, or running.

05

Prove Features Through Action

Show relevant features naturally while using the product. Avoid simply listing specifications.

06

End With a Natural CTA

Share your experience and direct viewers to the product using the provided offer, discount code, and link.

05

Content Guidelines

Do
  • Show both everyday movement and dedicated workout.
  • Choose a daily-life scenario that fits your content naturally.
  • Make product features visible through actions.
  • Use a strong visual hook instead of a generic introduction.
  • Keep the product integrated naturally into your content.
Don't
  • Limit the R3 to only an under-desk / WFH use case.
  • Use the R3 only as a traditional treadmill.
  • List features without showing them in context.
  • Spend too much time on unboxing or specifications.
  • Make the video feel like a traditional product commercial.
06

Posting Requirements

Usage
Include at least 3 natural, behavior-driven usage moments.
Promotion
Mention 20% OFF and your unique discount code.
Affiliate
Include the assigned affiliate link.
Caption
Keep the caption natural and based on your actual experience.
Features
Mention the key features actually demonstrated in the content.
Instagram
Co-post with WalkingPad and tag @walkingpad.
Hashtag
#walkingpad
